collegeInfo: VNIT Nagpur, established in 1960, is one of India’s premier NITs and an Institute of National Importance. Known for its academic rigor, innovative research, and excellent placements, VNIT offers a vibrant campus atmosphere with cutting-edge infrastructure and a wide range of technical and cultural activities.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Available to students with family income below ₹8 lakh and good academic standing.
Awarded to high-performing students in science streams under the DST, Govt. of India.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply on the DST INSPIRE portal.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: For reserved and economically weaker category students domiciled in Maharashtra.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply on Maharashtra DTE website and college office.

events.eventFullDescription: AXIS is VNIT’s flagship annual technical festival. It features robotics, coding, quizzes, workshops, guest lectures, and project showcases, drawing participants from all over India.
Aarohan is VNIT’s cultural extravaganza with music, dance, drama, literary contests, celebrity nights, and inter-college competitions.
Consortium blends business games, case competitions, stock market simulations, and leadership talks, providing a platform for budding managers.
Spandan is the annual sports festival at VNIT, where students compete in athletics, cricket, football, basketball, badminton, and more.

details.stage: JoSAA Counseling - Choice Filling & Seat Allocation

importantDates.event: B.Tech Admissions 2025 (via JEE Main and JoSAA)

infrastructure.infraDescription: VNIT Nagpur’s 225-acre lush green campus features academic and research buildings, smart classrooms, hi-tech labs, a large central library, 12+ boys' and girls' hostels, multiple dining halls, auditorium, fully equipped sports facilities, guest house, health centre, Wi-Fi, and a vibrant student club space.
